source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 8 Taxes, supplemental schedule of cash paid for income taxes
source.quote: The following is a supplemental schedule of cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds: 2026 U.S. federal $ 1,377 U.S. state and local: California 209 Other 322 Foreign: Canada 430 Mexico 185 Other 316 Total $ 2,839 [USD millions]

notes: Fiscal year ended August 30, 2026. Taxes: cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds (us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet), from the new by-jurisdiction schedule in Note 8 (Costco adopted ASU 2023-09 for fiscal 2026); the supplemental cash-flow line 'Income taxes, net' shows the same $2,839 million. R&D not reported as a separate line (retailer).
